question: How must the eightfold year be contemplated after the pores are filled?
premises: the object is the eightfold year
inference: The verse prescribes contemplating the eightfold year with an undistracted mind.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of vatsarāṣṭrakam is not specified here
plain_english: With an undistracted mind indeed one should contemplate the eightfold year.
